about: Thwaite's parked cars drawn with plain Fab models (beenster, Nov 10: 'Yes, 8 models, mixed colours'). Tools/ue_build_level.py place_fab_cars: each props.json SM_Car_N_Paint instance becomes one model, in turn, at its native size, its wheels on the ground, nose the way the generated car's was (+X). 'yaw' (degrees) turns a model whose own front isn't +X. Paint: every slot whose slot, material or base material name has 'Paint' in it (or a slot listed in 'paint_slots') wears MI_FabCarPaint_<n> in the next colour, since City Sample's car paint is black without its Blueprint. A model that isn't in the project is skipped and its car keeps the next model; with none found the old generated cars are drawn. The packs (City Sample Vehicles, Vehicle Variety Pack vol 1) live in /Content and are never committed. No brand names or logos in either; the taxi, police car and sports coupe are left out.
